planegcs glue built with -s DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0

source:    https://github.com/Salusoft89/planegcs
commit:    951ba1a56c7fbae17de05851a221129e185fa92c
toolchain: emscripten/emsdk:3.1.45 (upstream's own builder base)
patch:     -s DYNAMIC_EXECUTION=0 appended to LINK_FLAGS in planegcs/CMakeLists.txt
run:       https://github.com/MakerViking/sindricad/actions/runs/32002153102

The unpatched control build reproduced the published 1.1.7 planegcs.js
byte for byte. The WASM is deliberately NOT compared: it does not build
reproducibly in this toolchain (see the workflow comments), and it is not
vendored - the app keeps loading the published wasm from the npm package.
Only planegcs.js is intended for vendoring.
